kind: growth-trading 1.1.0 parity baseline (continuation OFF and ON)
numberEncoding: JSON numbers are exact doubles; NaN and ±Infinity are the strings "NaN", "Infinity", "-Infinity"

attribution.note: Descriptive attribution: each trade is credited to the mechanism that opened it. This is NOT the incremental (causal) effect of enabling a mechanism: enabling it changes which later signals are taken and so the whole trade sequence. The causal comparison is a complete ON run against an otherwise identical OFF run (path-dependent counterfactual).

continuation.note: Episode counts are descriptive. "Expired with a later higher high" counts windows that expired although a session high above the exit price followed inside the window (a possible missed continuation); it is not a profit estimate.
